# Previous-version compression fixtures

These synthetic fixtures were generated with the retained compiled `zstd 0.13.3`
dependency (`zstd-safe 7.2.4`, bundled zstd 1.5.7) before the 0.14.3 upgrade.
They are committed bytes, not generated by the decoder being tested.

- `source.txt`: synthetic multilingual memory text (3,360 bytes).
- `plain.zst`: `zstd::encode_all(source, 19)` (180 bytes).
- `dictionary.bin`: 1,024-byte dictionary trained from 128 synthetic samples.
- `dictionary.zst`: `bulk::Compressor::with_dictionary(19, dictionary)` output
  (31 bytes). It requires the dictionary and fails plain decompression.

The `reads_plain_and_dictionary_frames_written_by_zstd_0_13_3` regression checks
that the current plain and dictionary CCR decoders restore both frames exactly.
No user data, databases, credentials, or production memories are included.
